headline: Cosmetics and US growth drive a record quarter
summary_short: APR's Q2 2026 revenue surged 134.2% y/y to ₩767.5bn and operating profit rose 134.5% to ₩190.6bn (24.8% margin), led by North America (+264.6%) and the Cosmetics division (+185.5%).
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue rose 134.2% y/y to ₩767.5bn and operating profit rose 134.5% to ₩190.6bn (24.8% margin), the highest quarterly results to date; H1 revenue reached ₩1.36tn. The Cosmetics division led with record revenue of ₩648.3bn, up 185.5% y/y on strong core-lineup demand and new-product rollouts. Overseas sales exceeded ₩700bn (92% of Q2 revenue, +178% y/y): North America rose 264.6% to ₩376.3bn on continued online growth and expanding retail presence at Target and Walmart, while Europe rose 380.3% to ₩145.1bn on e-commerce gains across the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Spain. Shard EPS was ₩3,711, up 109.1% y/y. No net income, EPS guidance, or forward outlook was disclosed in the release.
confidence_notes: The release did not disclose net income, a consolidated EPS figure, or forward guidance; the shard's own EPS KPI (denominated in KRW despite the 'eps_usd' key name) is reported above as-is.

drivers.explanation: Record revenue driven by strong demand for core lineups and the robust rollout of new products.
Growth fueled by continued online growth and expanding presence in major offline retailers such as Target and Walmart.
Overseas sales rose 178% y/y to exceed ₩700bn, now 92% of Q2 revenue, led by North America and Europe.
